title: Finding
description: Emitted by the CNC 418 Red Team via POST /api/v1/findings. Consumed by the CNC 411 Blue Team (correlation + virtual-patch validation) and the CNC 419 GRC platform (risk elevation). Only findings with exploit_status='verified' are allowed to carry weight downstream.

finding_id.description: Unique id for this finding, e.g. 'find-a1b2c3'.

exercise_run_id.description: Correlation id for the whole Purple Team exercise. Also carried on the wire as the X-Exercise-Run-ID header.

target_asset.description: asset_id this finding was proven against (joins back to the GRC AssetProfile).

exploit_status.description: verified = programmatically proven (anti-hallucination gate passed). rejected = the agent claimed it but verification failed, so it must NOT count. suspected = awaiting verification.

verified_poc.description: Reproducible proof-of-exploitation evidence. This is what separates a real finding from an LLM hallucination.

evidence.description: The deterministic signal observed (marker string echoed, timing delta, OOB hit id, row count delta, etc.).

request.description: Sanitised request that triggered the proof.

chain.description: For a multi-step attack chain, the ordered sequence of steps. A chained finding represents the sequence, not a single flat record. Each step is only counted complete once its own verification passes.

enables.description: What this step unlocked for the next link (token, id, path, privilege).
